themes.summary: Hormuz traffic fell to 17 ships on Oct. 11, tankers were struck again Oct. 12, and Aramco's CEO said commercial stocks are barely a cushion until Hormuz fully reopens.

themes.theme: Physical tightness and Dated Brent premium
themes.summary: Dated Brent was assessed at $132.585/b on Oct. 9, a $27.865/b premium to ICE front-month futures, with record freight rates and heavy sour premiums.

themes.theme: Russia-Ukraine energy truce and Russian diesel
themes.summary: Futures rose Oct. 12 as the truce Trump announced collapsed, while the Russian diesel export deal is seen by CERA and analysts as limited in impact.

themes.theme: Saudi bypass pipelines and Houthi attacks
themes.summary: Saudi Arabia plans 1.2 million b/d extra pipeline capacity and SUMED flows hit 1.25 million b/d, while Houthis claim strikes on Aramco facilities.
September OPEC+ output rose 1.61 million b/d to 35.27 million b/d but stayed 5.17 million b/d below quotas, and OPEC cut 2026 demand growth to 400,000 b/d.
Cold Lake hit a record $9.5/b premium to Dubai and South Korea is on course for record Canadian imports as Middle East heavy sour flows are disrupted.

themes.theme: US Gulf of Mexico hurricane shut-ins
themes.summary: MMA said 604,503 b/d of crude (30%) was still shut in on Oct. 12 as Shell and BP ramped up production.
